subject: Mental Models
title: Pareto Principle
description: A quick, practical guide to Pareto Principle.

hook.text: A factory manager discovers that 20% of defects cause 80% of customer complaints.

buildup.text: The Pareto Principle says roughly 80% of effects come from 20% of causes.

discovery.text: Vilfredo Pareto observed in 1896 that 80% of Italian wealth belonged to 20% of people.

twist.text: People spread effort equally across all tasks. The Pareto Principle says most tasks barely matter.

punchline.text: Find the vital 20%. Most results live there.

quiz.question: What does the Pareto Principle roughly state?
options: 80% of effects come from 20% of causes
All causes contribute equally to effects
